description: List the Gmail accounts this server can use. Call it first when the user has not said which mailbox, or to learn the aliases to pass as "account" to every other tool. Returns each account's email, alias, and whether labels and calendar are enabled for it, the default account if one is set, and whether sending is enabled or the server is in drafts-only mode. Takes no input and changes nothing.
name: list_accounts
title: List mail accounts
